case_title: Velthepu Srinivas and Others v. State of Andhra Pradesh (Now State of Telangana) and Anr.
statutory_provisions: IPC s.302, s.34; IPC s.304 Part II
aggravating_circumstances: Political animosity, use of weapons, multiple assaults
trial_court_outcome: Convicted under s.302/34 IPC, life imprisonment
high_court_outcome: Confirmed conviction and sentence for A-1, A-2, A-4; modified for A-3
offence_finally_established: Murder under s.302 IPC for A-1, A-2, A-4; culpable homicide not amounting to murder under s.304 Part II IPC for A-3
neutral_facts: The accused, who were part of the same family, were involved in a political dispute with the victim, who was from the same village. On 15.11.2001, the victim was traveling in an auto-rickshaw when the accused stopped the vehicle and dragged the victim to the house of one of the accused. The accused then assaulted the victim with various weapons, including an axe, sword, stone, and knife, leading to the victim's death. The prosecution presented eyewitness accounts, a post-mortem report, and recovered weapons as evidence. The trial court and High Court convicted all four accused of murder under Section 302 IPC, but the Supreme Court modified the conviction of one accused to culpable homicide not amounting to murder under Section 304 Part II IPC due to insufficient evidence of a common intention to commit murder.
